title: Do you agree that providing bonuses or extra holidays is the most effective way to motivate employees?
text:
# Part 1 
I strongly agree that giving rewards is the best way to motivate employees.
There are several reasons to support my opinion.

# Part 2
First of all, it's really helpful for most employees.

# Part 3
For instance, five years ago, I was a newbie in the marketing department at ABC Company.

# Part 4
I had to put in long hours for so many team projects,/ and it was so stressful that I even worked on the weekend./ I was exhausted and really wanted to quit the job.

# Part 5
However, I stayed diligent, worked day and night, and finally completed them./ The performance was really great.

# Part 6
As a result, my boss gave me bonuses and 3 days off for a long holiday to Sydney./ It was motivating, made me happy, and I was able to work harder afterward.

# Part 7
Therefore, appropriate rewards can effectively help employees overcome stress.

segments.text: I strongly agree that giving rewards is the best way to motivate employees.
There are several reasons to support my opinion.
First of all, it's really helpful for most employees.
For instance, five years ago, I was a newbie in the marketing department at ABC Company.
I had to put in long hours for so many team projects,
and it was so stressful that I even worked on the weekend.
I was exhausted and really wanted to quit the job.
However, I stayed diligent, worked day and night, and finally completed them.
As a result, my boss gave me bonuses and 3 days off for a long holiday to Sydney.
It was motivating, made me happy, and I was able to work harder afterward.
Therefore, appropriate rewards can effectively help employees overcome stress.
